note: Resolution ranking. Data, not code. Changing this is an edit and a re-run; the claims never move.
_tiers_note: A human verdict TERMINATES resolution. It is not a weight - no quantity of agreeing sources can reach it, because sources can be wrong together and a number eventually gets tuned. Design 9.7, ruled 2026-09-04.
_human_note: Transcription is NOT adjudication. A person operating a lossy instrument does not enter here; only a person adjudicating evidence does. Design 3.7.
lineage_note: Independence is counted in lineage GROUPS, not sources. A claim with a non-empty attribution votes only in stated_by's group - the League cannot be outvoted by its opponent quoting it, nor corroborated by it. Design 3.6, 4.3.
_excluded_note: (source, predicate) pairs barred from voting. A pair with no source_score row is excluded at ranks 2 and 3.

rules.name: contemporaneous-over-aggregator
rules.evidence: Coaching Tree: 3 role errors in 5 teams, 1979 - a modern aggregator projects modern title structures onto teams that did not use them

_set_valued_note: Predicates whose subject may legitimately hold SEVERAL values at once. A coach can be Pass Game Coordinator AND Quarterbacks in one season; a 1950 player can be LOT and LDT. Resolving these as single-valued manufactured 344 false contests in the first coaching build - 100% of them from ONE source listing a man's roles. Set-valued predicates UNION within a lineage group and only contest ACROSS groups.
